# GitHub Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, and `docs/SECURITY.md` for every suggestion.

- Vite + Vanilla TypeScript + CSS (MPA); Supabase for evaluator area when added
- English file names (`kebab-case`); French UI text in HTML only
- Colors only in `src/styles/variables.css`
- Never `service_role` in client; RLS required on private Supabase data
- File documentation header on line 1 of each source file
